findings.evidenceJa: ぽん、と今更ながら気がつく
findings.governingReading: with a small clap, the realization belatedly strikes me
findings.explanation: The physical comic beat accompanying Shirou’s delayed realization is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: ランサーに胸を貫かれ
findings.governingReading: Lancer pierced me through the chest
findings.explanation: The wound’s location and penetrating severity are omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな大事
findings.governingReading: such a grave affair
findings.explanation: The enormity of the Grail War becomes mere informational quantity.

findings.highlight: I would fight, since I could not sit by and do nothing
findings.evidenceJa: この戦いが放っておけないから戦う
findings.governingReading: I will fight because I cannot leave this conflict unattended
findings.explanation: Shirou’s specific object and decision are generalized to inactivity.

findings.evidenceJa: 何も知らず、無関係に傷つく人間
findings.governingReading: people harmed despite knowing nothing and having no involvement
findings.explanation: Lack of knowledge and involvement become the moral category innocence.

findings.highlight: I have trained to become a superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になろうと魔術を鍛えてきた
findings.governingReading: I have trained my Magecraft in order to become an ally of justice
findings.explanation: Shirou’s decade of concrete magical training disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方
findings.governingReading: ally of justice
findings.explanation: The work’s central ethical term is again replaced by the genre label superhero.

findings.evidenceJa: 『誰かの為』になれる機会
findings.governingReading: an opportunity to become someone who exists “for someone else”
findings.explanation: Shirou’s identity ideal becomes a generic helpful act.

findings.highlight: The backwards desire that should not be wished for
findings.evidenceJa: 喜べ衛宮士郎
findings.governingReading: Rejoice, Emiya Shirou
findings.explanation: The first direct address of the disturbing inner voice is absent from the English page.

findings.highlight: The backwards desire that should not be wished for
findings.evidenceJa: 願ってはならないサカシマな願望
findings.governingReading: that perverse, inverted desire which must never be wished
findings.explanation: The morally inverted desire is rendered with nonidiomatic “backwards.”

findings.highlight: The backwards desire that should not be wished for
findings.evidenceJa: 君の望みは、ようやく叶う
findings.governingReading: Your wish will finally be granted
findings.explanation: The inner voice’s accusatory fulfillment claim is wholly absent from the English page.

findings.highlight: Might be a distorted wish for a superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方として、ひどく歪なのではないか
findings.governingReading: might make me terribly distorted as an ally of justice
findings.explanation: The source questions Shirou’s own moral deformation; the English assigns distortion to the wish.

findings.highlight: the wish I’ve had for ten years
findings.evidenceJa: 十年間守り続けた誓い
findings.governingReading: the oath I have upheld for ten years
findings.explanation: A maintained vow becomes a passive wish.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術を鍛えてきた
findings.governingReading: I have trained my Magecraft
findings.explanation: The work’s technical category Magecraft is generalized to magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 不当に命を奪われる“誰か”の為
findings.governingReading: for “someone” whose life would be unjustly taken
findings.explanation: The imagined individual victim and unjust deprivation of life disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの鎧姿は見あたらなかった
findings.governingReading: Saber’s armored figure was nowhere to be seen
findings.explanation: The narration’s focus on the conspicuous armor is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントは霊体になれる
findings.governingReading: Servants can assume spiritual form
findings.explanation: A reversible manifestation state is again described as ontological transformation.

findings.evidenceJa: 斬られれば血を流す
findings.governingReading: bleed when cut by a blade
findings.explanation: The blade-specific bodily vulnerability is generalized.

findings.highlight: Her clothes are now refined and suit her well
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女らしい上品な洋服
findings.governingReading: elegant Western clothes characteristic of her
findings.explanation: Clothing that expresses Saber’s character becomes clothing that merely suits her appearance.

findings.evidenceJa: 言葉を忘れた
findings.governingReading: I forget words
findings.explanation: Speechless absorption is changed into physiological loss of voice.

findings.highlight: removes the last of the doubts within me
findings.evidenceJa: 最後に残っていた棘が取れた
findings.governingReading: the last remaining thorn is pulled free
findings.explanation: A lingering painful obstruction becomes an intellectual doubt.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は聖なるものだ
findings.governingReading: she is something sacred
findings.explanation: Shirou’s categorical perception of Saber is weakened to possessing an unspecified holy quality.

findings.highlight: I won’t be led astray if I’m with her
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が間違った道を進む事はない
findings.governingReading: I will not proceed down the wrong path
findings.explanation: Shirou’s confidence in his own course becomes conditional dependence on Saber’s guidance.

findings.evidenceJa: 慌てた風もなく目蓋を開けて
findings.governingReading: Saber opens her eyes without the slightest sign of haste
findings.explanation: Saber’s composure is omitted.

findings.highlight: Saber looks at me as she speaks
findings.evidenceJa: まっすぐにこっちを見ながら、淡々とセイバーは言う
findings.governingReading: Saber speaks matter-of-factly while looking straight at me
findings.explanation: The direct gaze and controlled affect that produce Shirou’s tension are weakened.

findings.highlight: I take a step back and shake my head
findings.evidenceJa: ばっと一歩引いて、ぶるぶると首を振る
findings.governingReading: I spring a step backward and shake my head vigorously
findings.explanation: The abrupt, comic physical intensity is reduced.

findings.highlight: I don’t think it ever will
findings.evidenceJa: 収まりなんかつかない気がする
findings.governingReading: I feel as though I cannot get myself settled at all
findings.explanation: Immediate inability to settle becomes permanent.

findings.highlight: Perhaps her armor looked so surreal I didn’t notice yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: とにかく、彼女はとんでもない美人だ
findings.governingReading: in any case, she is an astonishing beauty
findings.explanation: The English inserts a source-free explanation that Saber’s surreal armor concealed her beauty.

findings.highlight: when she dresses like a girl, I’m flustered, as any healthy guy would be
findings.evidenceJa: 今さらに思い知らされた
findings.governingReading: I am made to realize her beauty all over again now
findings.explanation: The English inserts a source-free norm about feminine dress and a “healthy guy” reaction.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は苦手だ
findings.governingReading: I am not good at dealing with her
findings.explanation: Shirou’s relational discomfort with Saber becomes an unspecified troubled state.

findings.highlight: the first time we sit down and talk
findings.evidenceJa: こうやって落ち着いて話す
findings.governingReading: the first time we have spoken calmly like this
findings.explanation: The quality of the conversation becomes a seating arrangement.

findings.evidenceJa: さっきまでの穏やかさ
findings.governingReading: her composure until a moment ago
findings.explanation: Saber’s calm demeanor is recast as tenderness.

findings.highlight: It was not something you should have been hurt over
findings.evidenceJa: シロウが傷つく事ではなかった
findings.governingReading: it was not a situation in which Shirou should have been physically wounded
findings.explanation: Shirou’s bodily injury is rendered as something he should not feel hurt about.

findings.highlight: there is no way I can protect you
findings.evidenceJa: 私でも守りようがない
findings.governingReading: even I would have no way to protect you
findings.explanation: Saber’s emphasis on the limit applying even to her is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 淡々と語る少女
findings.governingReading: the girl speaks matter-of-factly
findings.explanation: Controlled affect becomes simplicity of content.

findings.highlight: It must be because she sounds so practical. She sounds so practical that
findings.evidenceJa: その姿があんまりにも事務的で
findings.governingReading: her manner is far too businesslike
findings.explanation: The English adds a repetitive explanatory sentence around Saber’s businesslike manner.

findings.evidenceJa: 意表を突かれたように固まった
findings.governingReading: she freezes as though caught completely off guard
findings.explanation: Saber’s total shocked stillness is weakened.

findings.highlight: Her look makes me realize what I’ve said
findings.evidenceJa: すごく場違いな台詞を言った
findings.governingReading: I realize I have said something terribly out of place
findings.explanation: The social reason for Shirou’s embarrassment is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 改めて訊く
findings.governingReading: let me ask anew or properly
findings.explanation: Shirou restarting the question is misread as formal register.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の意思には疑問を挟む余地などない
findings.governingReading: there is no room to doubt her resolve
findings.explanation: Certainty about Saber’s will becomes prohibition on argument.

findings.evidenceJa: 半人前の魔術師
findings.governingReading: a half-trained magus
findings.explanation: Shirou’s incomplete training status is again reduced to amateurism.

findings.highlight: you’re content with me as your Master
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はおまえのマスターでいいんだな
findings.governingReading: it is truly acceptable for me to be your Master
findings.explanation: Shirou asks for confirmation of the role; the English turns it into Saber’s emotional contentment.

findings.highlight: we Servants, who are also spirits
findings.evidenceJa: 同じ霊格を持つサーヴァントだけ
findings.governingReading: only Servants possessing the same spiritual rank as the spiritual Grail
findings.explanation: The shared spiritual-rank requirement for touching the Grail is omitted.

findings.highlight: the Holy Grail in spirit form
findings.evidenceJa: 霊体である聖杯
findings.governingReading: the Holy Grail, which is a spiritual entity
findings.explanation: The Grail’s nature is rendered as a temporary state.

findings.evidenceJa: “英霊”なんてとんでもない連中
findings.governingReading: extraordinary beings such as Heroic Spirits
findings.explanation: Heroic Spirits’ overwhelming stature is reduced to dismissive “something like.”

findings.highlight: you don’t care what measures you take to win
findings.evidenceJa: 勝つ為には手段を選ばない
findings.governingReading: you will not choose or limit your means in order to win
findings.explanation: A policy of unrestricted methods becomes emotional indifference.

findings.evidenceJa: マスターでもない無関係の人間
findings.governingReading: uninvolved people who are not Masters
findings.explanation: Two plot-relevant limits are replaced by moral innocence.

findings.evidenceJa: それは可能である手段ではありません
findings.governingReading: that is not among the means available to me
findings.explanation: Saber’s ethical definition of possible action becomes a vague impossibility.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分を裏切る事
findings.governingReading: betray myself
findings.explanation: Saber’s identity-level impossibility is narrowed to betraying propositions she believes.

findings.highlight: You will have to use one of your Command Spells
findings.evidenceJa: その刻印を一つ頂く
findings.governingReading: I will take one of those seals from you
findings.explanation: Saber’s threatened retaliatory agency becomes Shirou voluntarily spending a Command Spell.

findings.highlight: to compensate for trampling over me
findings.evidenceJa: 私に踏みいる代償
findings.governingReading: as the price for trespassing upon or violating my person and principles
findings.explanation: Saber’s language of intrusion is rendered as an awkward physical trampling image.

findings.highlight: Her lack of doubt gave her the image of a cold fighting machine
findings.evidenceJa: あまりの強さと迷いのなさに機械のようなイメージ
findings.governingReading: her overwhelming strength and freedom from hesitation had made her seem machine-like
findings.explanation: Half the basis for Shirou’s earlier impression is omitted and “cold fighting” is added.

findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントを召喚する魔術師
findings.governingReading: a magus who summons a Servant
findings.explanation: The defining singular Master–Servant relation becomes plural summoning.

findings.highlight: the names of the classes given to us
findings.evidenceJa: 役割毎につけられた呼称
findings.governingReading: designations assigned according to each role
findings.explanation: Role-based designations become names belonging to classes before the class mechanism is explained.

findings.highlight: beings that have reached the rank of gods
findings.evidenceJa: 神域まで上り詰めた存在
findings.governingReading: beings who climbed into the divine domain
findings.explanation: Approaching a divine domain becomes attaining the rank of gods.

findings.evidenceJa: 卓越した能力
findings.governingReading: outstanding abilities
findings.explanation: Excellence is changed into supernatural power.

findings.highlight: whose fame was such that they were promoted
findings.evidenceJa: 死後に祭り上げられ
findings.governingReading: were elevated through posthumous veneration
findings.explanation: The social or spiritual act of enshrinement becomes bureaucratic promotion caused by fame.

findings.evidenceJa: 精霊の域
findings.governingReading: the domain or rank of nature spirits
findings.explanation: A specific elevated spiritual category is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 英霊であるが故に
findings.governingReading: because we are Heroic Spirits
findings.explanation: The technical ontological category becomes ordinary heroism.

findings.highlight: we are all capable of defeating each other
findings.evidenceJa: お互いが必殺の力を持つ英霊
findings.governingReading: Heroic Spirits each possessing sure-kill power against the others
findings.explanation: A guaranteed lethal capability becomes mere ability to win.

findings.evidenceJa: “役割”に応じて選ばれている
findings.governingReading: selected according to their assigned role or class
findings.explanation: The Japanese role concept beneath the class term is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣士とか弓兵とか
findings.governingReading: like swordsman and archer
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inference from the English class names to their ordinary combat-role meanings disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 英霊をまるごと召喚する
findings.governingReading: summoning a Heroic Spirit in its entirety
findings.explanation: The difficulty of summoning the complete being becomes a distinction between true and false Heroic Spirits.

findings.highlight: only calls forth heroic spirits compatible with these vessels
findings.evidenceJa: この世界に我々が存在できる依り代を用意した
findings.governingReading: prepared anchors that allow us to exist in this world
findings.explanation: The vessels’ function as worldly anchors for Servant existence is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 役割という殻を被ったモノ
findings.governingReading: beings wearing the shell of a role or class
findings.explanation: The class as a limiting shell placed over a Heroic Spirit disappears.

findings.highlight: the weakness of the Saber class
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの欠点
findings.governingReading: my weakness as Saber
findings.explanation: Saber’s self-assessment becomes a universal class defect.

findings.evidenceJa: 白兵戦で優れている
findings.governingReading: superior to you in close combat
findings.explanation: The tactical domain is broadened from melee to all combat.

findings.evidenceJa: 正面から戦っても勝てない
findings.governingReading: could not win by fighting them head-on
findings.explanation: The loss condition tied to direct engagement becomes inability to win any combat.

findings.highlight: you’ll have to do it some other way
findings.evidenceJa: 剣以外で敵の息の根を断つ
findings.governingReading: use something other than the sword to stop the enemy’s breath
findings.explanation: The lethal conclusion of Saber’s tactical lesson is hidden behind “do it.”

findings.highlight: If your enemy discovers you are skilled in combat
findings.evidenceJa: 白兵戦で優れている、と相手に知られた
findings.governingReading: if the opponent learns that you are superior in close combat
findings.explanation: Specific revealed melee superiority becomes generic skill.

findings.evidenceJa: 気配を隠すという能力
findings.governingReading: has a special ability to conceal his presence
findings.explanation: The English contains a doubled article.

findings.highlight: versed in magic that does not exist in this age
findings.evidenceJa: この時代にない魔術に精通している
findings.governingReading: versed in Magecraft absent from this era
findings.explanation: The technical category Magecraft is generalized to magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 必殺の機会を持っている
findings.governingReading: possess an opportunity or means for a certain kill
findings.explanation: A lethal opportunity becomes a guaranteed attack as an owned object.

findings.highlight: weapons that symbolize them and make them heroes
findings.evidenceJa: 武具を持つが故に、英雄として特化している
findings.governingReading: their symbolic armaments distinguish and specialize them as particular heroes
findings.explanation: Symbolic equipment defining the hero’s specific legend becomes what makes the person a hero at all.

findings.evidenceJa: それぞれが強力な武具を携えています
findings.governingReading: each carries powerful armaments
findings.explanation: The potentially plural legendary equipment is reduced to one weapon.

findings.highlight: the thing we must take the most care of
findings.evidenceJa: 最も警戒すべき物
findings.governingReading: the thing against which we must be most vigilant
findings.explanation: A warning about greatest danger becomes awkward language suggesting care.

findings.evidenceJa: あり得ない軌跡
findings.governingReading: an impossible trajectory
findings.explanation: The causality-reversing path of Gáe Bolg becomes generic impressive movement.

findings.evidenceJa: 人の手におえる物ではない
findings.governingReading: not something human hands can control or contend with
findings.explanation: Human inability to handle the weapon becomes the weapon being unsuitable.

findings.evidenceJa: 槍っていう領域から出てなかった
findings.governingReading: it had not departed from the category of a spear
findings.explanation: An ontological category distinction becomes an evaluation of extraordinariness.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術なのか
findings.governingReading: is a Noble Phantasm Magecraft
findings.explanation: The work’s technical category Magecraft is generalized to magic.

findings.highlight: Noble Phantasms are certainly similar to magic
findings.evidenceJa: 宝具は魔術に近い
findings.governingReading: Noble Phantasms are close to Magecraft
findings.explanation: The technical comparison to Magecraft is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: カタチになった神秘
findings.governingReading: Mystery given form
findings.explanation: The setting term Mystery gains an unsupported divine qualifier.

findings.highlight: spells are necessary to activate magic
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術の発現に詠唱が必要
findings.governingReading: incantation is required for the manifestation of Magecraft
findings.explanation: The technical process and category are both altered.

findings.evidenceJa: 自らの欠点をもさらけ出す
findings.governingReading: also expose their own weakness
findings.explanation: A revealed specific fatal weakness is expanded to every weakness.

findings.evidenceJa: 今後の対策を練ります
findings.governingReading: to devise future countermeasures
findings.explanation: Security planning against identified threats becomes generic planning.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなにあっさりと
findings.governingReading: agree so readily or casually
findings.explanation: Saber’s surprise at Shirou’s lack of resistance becomes surprise at speed.

findings.highlight: the only enemy I know is Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 判っている相手は遠坂だけ
findings.governingReading: the only other participant or opponent I know about is Tohsaka
findings.explanation: Rin is prematurely categorized as Shirou’s enemy.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is ready to fight me any day
findings.evidenceJa: 向こうはやる気満々
findings.governingReading: she is fully eager and ready to fight
findings.explanation: An intensity of present willingness becomes an invented temporal claim.

findings.highlight: I don’t really know what I should be doing
findings.evidenceJa: 勝手が分からない
findings.governingReading: I do not understand how any of this works or how to proceed
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lack of practical orientation becomes a generic uncertainty about what task to perform.

findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントはそれ自体が強力な魔力
findings.governingReading: a Servant is itself a mass or source of powerful magical energy
findings.explanation: Servant ontology as concentrated magical energy becomes “magic.”

findings.highlight: I am sure you felt Berserker’s presence
findings.evidenceJa: シロウもバーサーカーの気配は感じ取れたでしょう？
findings.governingReading: you too were able to sense Berserker’s presence, were you not?
findings.explanation: Saber’s confirming question becomes her assertion of certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術を生業とする
findings.governingReading: practice Magecraft as their vocation
findings.explanation: The magus’s professional relation to Magecraft is generalized and made colloquial.

findings.highlight: I can’t do that sort of thing
findings.evidenceJa: そんな器用な真似はできない
findings.governingReading: I cannot manage a delicate or skillful feat like that
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-assessment of technical finesse is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 半人前
findings.governingReading: half-trained or incomplete
findings.explanation: Shirou’s training status is again reduced to amateurism.

findings.highlight: The only evidence I’m even a Master is this Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: マスターとしての証も令呪だけ
findings.governingReading: the Command Spells are my only mark as a Master
findings.explanation: The Master’s identifying mark is reduced to one demonstrative spell.

findings.evidenceJa: 肩で息をつく
findings.governingReading: I breathe with my shoulders heaving
findings.explanation: A visible bodily action is changed to an emotional sigh.

findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸を整えてください
findings.governingReading: steady or regulate your breathing
findings.explanation: An instruction to actively regulate breathing becomes normal respiration.

findings.highlight: a faint pressure on my forehead
findings.evidenceJa: 額に触れる微かな感触
findings.governingReading: the faint sensation of something touching my forehead
findings.explanation: Tactile contact becomes pressure.

findings.evidenceJa: 刃物の先
findings.governingReading: the tip of a bladed object
findings.explanation: Shirou’s uncertain fear of an unidentified blade becomes certainty that it is Saber’s sword.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識を静める
findings.governingReading: quiet my awareness or consciousness
findings.explanation: A focused perceptual technique becomes general emotional calming.

findings.evidenceJa: どのようなカタチで把握したのか
findings.governingReading: in what form you apprehended it
findings.explanation: Personal cognitive representation is narrowed to vision.

findings.evidenceJa: 獣に喩えて見分ける
findings.governingReading: distinguish Servants by likening them to beasts
findings.explanation: An interpretive analogy becomes a categorical taxonomy.

findings.highlight: a standard concept for a Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターとしての基本
findings.governingReading: a fundamental skill of being a Master
findings.explanation: A practical core ability becomes conceptual knowledge.

findings.highlight: Like me, once you see someone, you shall understand their details
findings.evidenceJa: 私と同様、一度見た相手ならばその詳細が理解出来ている
findings.governingReading: as with me, you should understand the details of any opponent you have seen once
findings.explanation: The reference to Saber as the first example and the combat-relevant opponent are blurred into seeing “someone.”
